foundry_calls.text: Fifty feet of hemp. One silver. You want it coiled proper or slung over your shoulder like a farmhand?
foundry_calls.speaker: Wenna

foundry_calls.text: She cuts the rope from a great spool with a hooked knife, measuring by her forearm without a single wasted motion.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: I buy fifty feet of hempen rope from the chandler.

stream_metrics.step: I buy fifty feet of hempen rope from the chandler.
